48 Teachers to Receive National Awards on Teachers' Day

On the occasion of Teachers' Day, 48 teachers are set to be honored with National Awards. Among them, Uttar Pradesh will have three recipients, while Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, and Bihar will each have two teachers receiving the national recognition. One teacher from Uttar Pradesh was noted for creating 700 videos to teach mathematics. Separately, 33 teachers from Madhya Pradesh are being recognized with state-level awards.
